simple.meaning: כִּפָּה (kippâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a leaf of a palmtree.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Job, Isaiah, beginning at Job 15:32. Its contexts include Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כִּפָּה (H3712).

definitions.full: H3712. kippah כִּמָּה noun feminine branch frond (probably of palm tree, compare כַּף 3d ); — ׳כ Isa 9:13 ; 19:15 figurative of nobles, rulers (both opposed to אַגְמוֺן rush , i.e. high and low; || וְזָנָב רֹאשׁ ); with suffix כִּמָּתוֺ Job 15:32 (of wicked under figure of palm-tree). I. כפר (of following; original meaning dubious, but most probably cover , compare Arabic cover, hide ; > RS who thinks of Aramaic כָפַר , Pa`el wash away, rub off whence כִּמֶּר כֹּפֶר of washing away, obliteration of sin: Late Hebrew כִּמֶּר , Aramaic כַּמֵּר and derive.; Arabic an expiation (see RS OTJC 438; 2. 381 Kn on Lev 4:20 Ri Begr. Der Sühne We compare 335 f. Sm AT Rel. Geschichte. 321 Now Archaeology ii, 192 Dr Deut 425 Schmoller St,Kr. 1891, 205 ff. Lag BN 230 ff. )). **On original meaning compare now Dr Hast. DB PROPITIATION ; also Assyrian kuppuru , purify (and derivatives takpirtu ) Zim KAT 3. 601 f. Morgenstern Sin in Babylonian Religion (MVG 1905, 3) 44, 122 .
